0022600040.text: The Spurs, now 10-2 and 1st in the Southwest, host the Warriors in their 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. San Antonio has won 10 straight, going 6-0 on the road and 4-2 at home, while Golden State is 8-3, 3rd in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back, on an 8-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Spurs won the most recent meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026. San Antonio is missing Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Golden State is without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdominal soreness and is a game-time decision.
